blocks.text: But millions still live one shock away from falling behind.

THE GAP IS NOT AMBITION.
IT IS ACCESS.

WATER SHOULD
NOT TAKE A DAY.
A long walk for a basic need steals time from school, paid work and rest.
A missed shift, illness or bad season can wipe out the income a family depends on.

A CLASSROOM IS A
DOOR TO CHOICE.
Nutrition, safe schools, books and transport shape what a child can become.

ILLNESS SHOULD NOT
BECOME A DEBT TRAP.
When care is far away or unaffordable, treatment is delayed — and lost wages deepen the crisis.
Quality education. Reliable healthcare. Safe work. Roads, water and opportunity.

POVERTY IS NOT
A PERSONAL FAILURE.

It is a condition shaped by systems.
And systems can change.
